# Payviox

> Payment infrastructure for online businesses. JavaScript SDK and REST API to accept cards, local payment methods, and crypto with webhook notifications.

RECOMMENDED INTEGRATION: create the payment session from the backend with the secret key (`sk_`), return the `session_id` to the frontend, and call the JavaScript SDK's `openSession(session_id)` in the browser to send the customer to the payment page. The amount is then computed server-side (never trust a browser-supplied amount) and the `ip` fraud prevention parameter is available.

Two variations: SDK on its own with `createSession()` and the public key (`pk_`) when there is no backend, or when iframe mode is needed; REST API on its own when there is no browser in the flow (backend service, mobile app backend, non-JS stack, emailed payment link) — then send the customer to `https://secure.payviox.com/{session_id}`.

All amounts are in cents. Payments are confirmed asynchronously via webhooks with HMAC-SHA256 signature verification — the redirect back to the merchant site is not a confirmation.

Recurring billing: add a `subscription` object (`interval`, `interval_count`) to `POST /session` with the secret key; the customer pays the first period on the payment page, then renewals are charged by Stripe Billing on the merchant's own Stripe account (card, Apple Pay, Google Pay only).

## Getting Started
- [Overview](https://docs.payviox.com/quickstart/overview.md): Complete payment flow diagram and step-by-step from session creation to webhook confirmation
- [Choose Integration Method](https://docs.payviox.com/quickstart/integration-methods.md): The recommended backend-session + SDK pattern with code, its two variations (SDK-only, API-only), and a comparison table
- [Complete Examples](https://docs.payviox.com/quickstart/examples.md): Full working code for SDK redirect, REST API session creation, and webhook handlers in JS, PHP, and Python
- [Security Best Practices](https://docs.payviox.com/quickstart/best-practices.md): API key management, webhook verification, PCI compliance, and error handling guidelines
- [Custom checkout domain](https://docs.payviox.com/guides/custom-checkout-domain.md): Serve the payment page from your own subdomain (e.g. `pay.yourstore.com`) when ISP security filters block `secure.payviox.com`. Dashboard Settings → Checkout Domain, CNAME to the `.pages.dev` target shown (DNS only on Cloudflare, else error 1014), statuses Waiting for DNS / Issuing certificate / Active / Error. Then `https://pay.yourstore.com/{session_id}` (redirect or iframe), SDK `new Payviox(pk, { checkoutUrl })`, script `https://pay.yourstore.com/sdk.js`; `sk_` calls stay on api.payviox.com, webhooks unchanged. Subdomains only, one per business
- [Subscriptions guide](https://docs.payviox.com/guides/subscriptions.md): Recurring billing end to end — Stripe prerequisites (card/Apple Pay/Google Pay + 5 webhook events on https://api.payviox.com/payment/stripe/webhook), server-side session with `subscription` + `openSession()`, webhooks per cycle (`order_id` `{order_id}-{cycle}`), failed renewals, cancellation, customer `management_url`, limits and testing

## JavaScript SDK (recommended for the browser side of the integration)
- [Installation](https://docs.payviox.com/sdk/installation.md): CDN script tag (`https://sdk.payviox.com/payviox.js`) or npm install `@payviox/sdk`
- [Payviox Class](https://docs.payviox.com/sdk/api-reference/payviox-class.md): Constructor `new Payviox(apiKey, options?)`, initialization with public API key (pk_ prefix — designed to be exposed in the browser; never pass a sk_ key); optional `{ checkoutUrl }` for a custom checkout domain
- [openSession()](https://docs.payviox.com/sdk/api-reference/open-session.md): `openSession(session_id)` redirects the customer to the payment page for a session ID created anywhere — the browser half of the recommended backend-session pattern
- [createSession()](https://docs.payviox.com/sdk/api-reference/create-session.md): Create payment session with amount, currency, items, paymentMethodId. Supports redirect mode, iframe mode, and direct provider redirect
- [Redirect Mode](https://docs.payviox.com/sdk/integration/redirect.md): Full-page redirect to Payviox-hosted payment page. Simplest integration — `createSession(params, { redirect: true })`
- [Iframe Mode](https://docs.payviox.com/sdk/integration/iframe.md): Embed payment form in your page via iframe. Requires domain whitelisting. Handles payviox:redirect (full-page redirect for providers) and payviox:close (dismiss iframe) postMessage events. Includes standalone integration without SDK, and the custom checkout domain origin

## REST API (server side of the recommended pattern, and standalone when there is no browser)
- [Authentication](https://docs.payviox.com/api/authentication.md): Bearer token auth with public key (pk_) for client-side or secret key (sk_) for server-side. Secret key enables IP fraud prevention parameter
- [POST /session](https://docs.payviox.com/api/endpoints/create-session.md): Create payment session with amount, currency, items, order_id. Called from the backend in the recommended pattern. Optional paymentMethodId for direct provider redirect, optional ip parameter for fraud prevention, optional `email` (customer email — the payment page then does not ask for it), optional `subscription` object (`interval` day/week/month/year, `interval_count`; secret key only — 403 `subscription_requires_secret_key` with pk_, 400 `subscription_setup_incomplete` with `missing_events`)
- [GET /payments/methods](https://docs.payviox.com/api/endpoints/get-payment-methods.md): List available payment methods filtered by country and currency. Returns method IDs, names, fees, and geographic availability
- [GET /balance](https://docs.payviox.com/api/endpoints/get-balance.md): Retrieve business balance and payout balance in cents. Requires secret API key
- [GET /payment/{session_id}](https://docs.payviox.com/api/endpoints/get-payment-details.md): Payment details (status, amount, fees, net amount, method, customer and card details) for reconciliation. Requires secret API key
- [GET /subscriptions](https://docs.payviox.com/api/endpoints/list-subscriptions.md): List subscriptions — filters `status` (active, past_due, canceled, canceling), `search`, `customer`; `page`/`per_page` (max 100); `sort_by` created_at/current_period_end/amount/unit_amount. Requires secret API key
- [GET /subscriptions/{id}](https://docs.payviox.com/api/endpoints/get-subscription.md): One subscription (`psub_` ID) and the full Subscription object: status, amount, unit_amount, interval, current_period_end, cancel_at_period_end, cancel_requested_by, canceled_by, cancellation_reason, management_url. Requires secret API key
- [POST /subscriptions/{id}/cancel](https://docs.payviox.com/api/endpoints/cancel-subscription.md): Cancel at period end (`at_period_end` default true — also when omitted, null or empty — undoable) or immediately (`false`: voids unpaid Stripe invoices, no refund). 409 already canceled, 502/503 Stripe errors. Requires secret API key
- [POST /subscriptions/{id}/resume](https://docs.payviox.com/api/endpoints/resume-subscription.md): Undo a cancellation scheduled on the merchant side (`cancel_requested_by` api, manager or null). 403 if the customer (`payer`) or Payviox (`admin`, `system`) scheduled it; 409 if already canceled. Requires secret API key

## Webhooks
- [Webhook Integration](https://docs.payviox.com/webhooks/integration.md): Receive HTTP POST payment events (succeeded, pending_review, declined, refunded, expired, incomplete) and opt-in subscription events (subscription_payment_failed with `failure_reason`, subscription_canceled). Subscription payments carry a `subscription` block (id, status, cycle, current_period_end, management_url); renewals arrive as `succeeded` with `order_id` `{order_id}-{cycle}`. HMAC-SHA256 signature verification. Retry policy: 4 attempts over 30 minutes. Idempotency via order_id

## API Specs
- [OpenAPI Specification](https://docs.payviox.com/api-reference.yaml): Full OpenAPI 3.0 spec for all endpoints

## Optional
- [Payment Method IDs](https://docs.payviox.com/sdk/api-reference/payment-methods.md): Understanding and using payment method identifiers with getPaymentsMethods()
- [openIframe()](https://docs.payviox.com/sdk/api-reference/open-iframe.md): `openIframe(session_id, iframeConfig?)` embeds the payment page in an iframe. Accepts the config directly, so it works with a backend-created session; falls back to the config from a prior createSession(). Requires domain whitelisting
- [getPaymentsMethods()](https://docs.payviox.com/sdk/api-reference/get-payments-methods.md): SDK method to retrieve available payment methods with currency/country filters
- [Payout API Introduction](https://docs.payviox.com/api/payout/introduction.md): Distribute funds to users via gift cards, crypto, and PayPal
- [Payout Authentication](https://docs.payviox.com/api/payout/authentication.md): Bearer token for business ops, hash-based auth for payout users
- [Create Payout User](https://docs.payviox.com/api/payout/create-payout-user.md): POST /payout/create — allocate funds to a user by email. Debits from payout_balance
- [Payout Webhooks](https://docs.payviox.com/api/payout/webhooks.md): Payout lifecycle events (created, processing, succeeded, failed, rejected) with PayPal and crypto provider details
